verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Split endpoint that returns page ranges for natural-language-described sections and a Classify endpoint for document type. It also documents workflows/Pipelines that chain classification, parsing and extraction into single API calls, which together cover the building blocks of packet splitting. The evidence never shows split and classify combined so that one packet upload automatically yields per-document typed results, and Split appears to return page numbers rather than processed per-document outputs. Missing for 10: explicit documented packet-splitting into individual documents with per-segment classification and extraction in one call, Split included as a chained workflow step, independent or hands-on corroboration.
